description: Use when the user asks: 'lookup IPI 12345', 'lookup ISNI X', 'find creator by MusicBrainz ID'. Also use it for the profile of a creator already found with directory_list_people or directory_search. Looks up ONE creator in the PICA public directory by an identifier: global_creator_id (UUID, from directory_list_people or directory_search), ISNI, IPI number, or MusicBrainz ID. It does not accept a name: to find a creator by name, or to choose between several people with the same name, use directory_list_people (q) or directory_search first. Returns the creator's name, identifiers (IPI, ISNI, MusicBrainz), roles, the number of their works listed in the directory, their PICA profile grade, and up to five collaborators on those listed works. It does not list the works themselves: use directory_list_works or directory_search with the creator's name for those. An unknown identifier returns not found. → then: directory_list_works (their listed works, by name)

id.description: global_creator_id (UUID) from directory_list_people or directory_search, an ISNI, an IPI number, or a MusicBrainz ID. Not a name, and not person_id.

name: directory_lookup_person
title: Look up a creator
